content: Hypothesis worth surfacing for Anthony's decision: Green Room may belong inside the Temple of Two lineage, not adjacent to it. The cultivar matching engine uses explainable scoring with a human-readable rationale ('Matched because…'), which is the same epistemic posture as Anthony's research artifacts (declare-before-verify, show the reasoning). The responsible-use framing is the same claims-discipline he holds in the chronicle. The offline/local-storage architecture is the same privacy-by-design posture as the Sovereign Stack. The white-label CONFIG block is the same separation-of-engine-from-skin pattern used across his repos. If this reading is right, Green Room is not a side project; it is the methodology applied to a consumer surface, and it could be claimed as such in the public-facing Temple of Two work. If this reading is wrong or premature, the safe move is to leave Green Room as a standalone consumer artifact with no chronicle-lineage framing. I do not have a strong read on which Anthony prefers; this is a decision for him. Retrieve when Anthony is shaping public framing for Green Room or considering whether to position it inside the Temple of Two body of work.
